question: Which was the first Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) to be established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT, Kharagpur**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **IIT, Kharagpur** was the first Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) to be established.
 
• It was established in **1951** and is located in Kharagpur, West Bengal.
 
• IIT Kharagpur was the first of the IITs to be established and is recognized as an Institute of National Importance.
 
• The establishment of IIT Kharagpur was based on the recommendations of the Sarkar Committee, which was formed to consider the establishment of higher technical institutions in India.
 
• Over the years, IIT Kharagpur has grown into one of the premier engineering institutions in India, offering a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) are autonomous public technical and research universities located across India.
 
• They are governed by the Institutes of Technology Act, 1961, which has declared them as institutions of national importance.
 
• The IIT system has 23 institutes, and it is known for its high academic standards and significant contributions to technology and engineering education in India.
 
• The IITs are known for their rigorous selection process, which includes the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) - one of the most challenging engineering entrance exams in the world.
 
• Graduates from IITs are highly sought after by employers worldwide, and many have gone on to achieve significant success in various fields.
